sourceHashScope: Probe, artefact filter, eligibility layer, opportunity registry, 006 identity, 030 recovery ledger, 048 following, 036 signals, 044 context, 025 filter and the reused 044 fixture; not a verified transitive dependency closure

protocol.arms: world / chain / filter per repetition, sequential, one process, no concurrent load
protocol.workload: 1 subject (vehicle-0) observed, real 036 signal controller advancing consecutive ticks over the 044 fixture, real 044 context/leader and 025 keyboard filter; the 088 filter evaluated at the real 219 decision cadence (every 6 ticks) over one 800-tick ride segment (BEFORE/WARMUP + MEASURED), with one injected real-contract 028 collision at tick 300 and one injected real-contract 030 recovery placement at tick 420
protocol.seed: none; deterministic tick-modulo input pattern and a fixed fixture
protocol.clock: performance.now only; fixed synthetic tick index (no wall clock in the fixture)
protocol.budget: Added cost must stay far below the 5.5 ms provisional full-tick p95 ceiling; no isolated budget claimed
injected: The 044 fixture carries no collision, so the real 028 incident contract and 028 createStableId identity are injected at one tick.
The 044 fixture carries no recovery, so a real 030 RecoveryRecord-compatible fact is injected at one tick.
The 044 fixture declares no STOP stop line, so the real 037 event contract and 037 identity are injected with parseSimulationEvent.
The real 038 priority-yield identity is injected through the registry stimulus port.
The stimulus observability is declared by a controlled fixture; the 017 camera pose/occlusion path is covered by the unit suite.
The 10 Hz consumer drains a queue; the world always steps every fixed tick.
No suspension is injected in the timed ride; the pause arm is covered by the unit suite and the self-check.

scope: Native Node CPU and owned-memory cost of the 088 artefact filter on top of the real 086/087 chain on the reused 044/085 fixture. No renderer, browser, GPU, FPS or realtime-throughput claim.
exclusions: No browser, renderer, GPU or FPS measurement; the 052 record documents an unresolved WebGPU presentation stall on this laptop.
Heap counters are diagnostic only; exact ownership is reported from the artefact counters.
Forced GC between repetitions is not used inside the timed region.
BEFORE is the same fixture with the 086/087/088 layers disabled, not a historical commit: 088 is purely additive.
